content.text:
Thirty-eight files use `useCompatSearchParams` from `packages/lib/hooks/useCompatSearchParams.ts`. Of those, 34 call it directly, and four test files mock it or call the mock:

- `packages/ui/components/dialog/dialog.test.tsx` mocks it.
- `packages/ui/components/form/wizard/wizardForm.test.tsx` mocks it.
- `apps/web/modules/test-setup.ts` is the shared test setup, which mocks it.
- `packages/features/bookings/lib/bookingSuccessRedirect.test.ts` mocks it and sets its return value.

I did not open `packages/lib/hooks/useCompatSearchParams.test.ts` to see how it imports the hook. I included it because its name says it tests this function.

I left out two files that match the name but don't use the `packages/lib` function. `packages/embeds/embed-core/src/useCompatSearchParams.tsx` defines a separate hook with the same name. `packages/embeds/embed-core/src/embed-iframe.ts` imports that local one through `./useCompatSearchParams`.
